say:4:1322009003:1.text: Not just me, but Gary, Rivanna, Alex, Alna, and Briley too... we've all been taken out to play together!
say:4:1322009003:1.source_cn: 不光是我，杰洛米和里芙娜，还有亚历克斯、阿尔娜、贝泽卡...

say:5:1322009004:1.text: Yeah, it's so much fun! I go to bed, fall asleep, and before long, I wake up by the river! Then we ice skate, have snowball fights, and just have fun together!
say:5:1322009004:1.source_cn: 嗯！可有趣了！我只管上床睡觉，等睡着后过不了多久，再睁...

say:6:1322009005:1.text: Yeah, and no matter how loud we laugh, no one tells us we're being too noisy!
say:6:1322009005:1.source_cn: 对呀对呀， 不管我们笑得多大声都没人嫌我们吵！

say:7:1322009006:1.text: There's also a strange little boy we've never met. He looks a little odd, but he's fun to play with. I showed him how to skate, and he learned it instantly!

choice_prompt:8:1322009006.text: There's also a strange little boy we've never met. He looks a little odd, but he's fun to play with. I showed him how to skate, and he learned it instantly!
choice_prompt:8:1322009006.source_cn: 有个没见过的小男孩也和我们一起玩，他虽然样子怪怪的，但其实可厉害了。我教他滑冰，他一学就会！

say:9:1322009007:1.text: Yes, he looks about the same age as us, but he's definitely not from town. I've never seen him before.
say:9:1322009007:1.source_cn: 嗯，他看上去和我们差不多大，但肯定不是镇上的人，我以前...

say:10:1322009008:1.text: He had bandages all over his body, including his face, like he was really hurt... but he didn't seem to care and had fun with us all night.
say:10:1322009008:1.source_cn: 他全身上下都缠着绷带，脸上也有，像是受过伤……但他好像...

choice_prompt:11:1322009008.text: He had bandages all over his body, including his face, like he was really hurt... but he didn't seem to care and had fun with us all night.
choice_prompt:11:1322009008.source_cn: 他全身上下都缠着绷带，脸上也有，像是受过伤……但他好像一点都不在乎，每次都玩得可开心了！

say:12:1322009009:1.text: No, never. Maybe because of the injuries on his face, he doesn't want to be laughed at. Adults are mean sometimes.
say:12:1322009009:1.source_cn: 是呀！我猜他肯定是因为脸上受过伤，怕被人嘲笑，所以不愿...

say:13:1322009010:1.text: None of us cared what he looked like, and we had a great time together. But he really didn't like to talk. He didn't even tell us his name...
say:13:1322009010:1.source_cn: 大家玩得那么高兴，才没人会嘲笑他！不过他的确不爱讲话，...

say:14:1322009012:1.text: Maybe Alex knows his name. They spent the most time together.
say:14:1322009012:1.source_cn: 说不定亚历克斯知道他叫什么，他们俩玩得最好了！

choice_prompt:15:1322009012.text: Maybe Alex knows his name. They spent the most time together.
choice_prompt:15:1322009012.source_cn: 说不定亚历克斯知道他叫什么，他们俩玩得最好了！

say:16:1322009013:6.text: Oh, it's that boy who built snowmen with us at the festival.
say:16:1322009013:6.source_cn: 是那个在祭典上和我们一起堆过雪人的孩子。

say:17:1322009015:0.text: In that case, let's begin by <style="highlight">checking around these children's homes for clues</style>. Then <style="highlight">we can go ask Alex</style>—he might know more details.

say:18:1322009016:1.text: Okay, let's start right away. Otherwise, Captain Rodrigo will be very worried!

say:20:1322009014:6.text: Oh yes, he's really good at making snowmen.

say:21:1322009011:1.source_cn: 呃……没、没问过……哎呀，反正大家一起玩得开心，不知道...
